notification.meaning: Wrapped notification row. If absent, the payload itself is the row. Other row keys are forwarded intact.

id.meaning: Notification identity; must contain a non-whitespace character. Applies inside the wrapper or at the flat row.

kind.meaning: Notification family; must contain a non-whitespace character. Applies inside the wrapper or at the flat row.

title.meaning: Title; must contain a non-whitespace character. Applies inside the wrapper or at the flat row.

color.meaning: Required severity color. Applies inside the wrapper or at the flat row.

id.meaning: Notification identity read back from the door.

state.meaning: State returned by the ledger, which can preserve a previously terminal row.

forwarded.meaning: Present when a non-gateway Caduceus forwarded the post.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Local validation or transport refusal, or the decoded Caduceus refusal passed through unchanged.
